sections.title: Best Ways to Maintain Good Mileage

location.heading: Best Ways to Maintain Good Mileage

blocks.text: Achieving and maintaining good mileage is essential for saving fuel costs, reducing environmental impact, and ensuring your vehicle’s long-term health. Whether you drive a petrol, diesel, hybrid, or electric car from Aventro Motors, the following practices will help you get the most out of every journey.

location.heading: Best Ways to Maintain Good Mileage
1. Regular Maintenance

items.text: Follow Service Schedules: Stick to the manufacturer's recommended service intervals for oil changes, air filter replacements, and other checks.
Use Genuine Parts: Always use genuine Aventro spare parts for optimal performance (e.g., Air Filter, Spark Plug, Oil Filter).

location.heading: Best Ways to Maintain Good Mileage
2. Check Tyre Pressure

items.text: Maintain Proper Pressure: Under-inflated tyres increase rolling resistance and decrease mileage.
Check Regularly: Inspect tyre pressure at least once a month and before long trips.

location.heading: Best Ways to Maintain Good Mileage
3. Drive Smoothly

items.text: Avoid Sudden Acceleration or Braking: Rapid changes waste fuel and energy.
Use Gentle Throttle Inputs: Gradual acceleration and deceleration help maximize efficiency.

location.heading: Best Ways to Maintain Good Mileage
4. Limit Idling

items.text: Turn Off Engine at Long Stops: Idling consumes fuel needlessly in petrol/diesel vehicles.
Use Start-Stop Feature If Equipped: Many Aventro models have this for additional savings.

location.heading: Best Ways to Maintain Good Mileage
5. Reduce Excess Weight

items.text: Remove Unnecessary Items: Extra load in the boot or cabin means more work for your engine.
Avoid Unused Racks: Roof boxes or roof racks can reduce aerodynamic efficiency.

location.heading: Best Ways to Maintain Good Mileage
6. Monitor Battery Health (For Hybrids & Electrics)

items.text: Regular Battery Checks: Ensure the battery pack is in good health to maximize the range.
Use Fast Charging Sparingly: Reserve fast-charging for emergencies to prolong battery life.

location.heading: Best Ways to Maintain Good Mileage
7. Use the Right Fuel & Lubricants

items.text: Recommended Grade: Always use the manufacturer-recommended fuel and lubricants for your vehicle.
High-Quality Products: Inferior products can harm efficiency and engine health.

location.heading: Best Ways to Maintain Good Mileage
8. Maintain Alignment and Suspension

items.text: Wheel Alignment: Misaligned wheels can drag and reduce mileage.
Suspension Health: Worn-out suspension components (like Shock Absorbers) affect efficiency.

location.heading: Best Ways to Maintain Good Mileage
9. Use Air Conditioning Wisely

items.text: AC Usage: Use Air Conditioning only when necessary as it can put extra load on the engine.
Ventilation First: Try ventilation on cooler days instead of AC.

location.heading: Best Ways to Maintain Good Mileage
10. Smart Driving Habits

items.text: Maintain Steady Speeds: Use cruise control on highways if available.
Plan Routes: Avoid congested routes which lead to excessive stop-start driving.
